# The Human Index

> A civilizational stress index: 25 countries scored 0-100 across 29
> indicators grouped into five meta-indexes (economic, social, mental,
> technological, environmental). Every number is source-attributed
> (World Bank, Eurostat, OECD, IMF WEO, ERA5, IHME, Gallup, World Happiness
> Report, EVS/WVS, DataReportal and more) and the derived dataset is open
> under CC BY-NC 4.0.

The composite score maps to five bands: up to 25 low, up to 45 moderate,
up to 65 elevated, up to 80 high, above 80 critical. The pipeline re-checks
every source daily, but most inputs are annual, so the composite moves when
publishers release new editions; a separate Live layer tracks monthly and
daily signals. Each value keeps its raw source value, reference date and
normalization bounds.

## Live data

- [Current snapshot](https://thehumanindex.org/llms-full.txt): full ranking, domain scores, Live signals, indicator sources and citation format, regenerated daily

## Key pages

- [Country rankings](https://thehumanindex.org/countries): all 25 tracked countries with live composite scores
- [Methodology](https://thehumanindex.org/methodology): how the index is computed, normalization bounds, band thresholds
- [Indicators](https://thehumanindex.org/indicators): all 29 indicators with sources and definitions
- [Top 10 rankings](https://thehumanindex.org/top-10): ranked lists (most/least stressed countries, loneliness, housing, and more)
- [Topics](https://thehumanindex.org/topics): topic hubs aggregating related indicators
- [Glossary](https://thehumanindex.org/glossary): plain-language definitions of every term used
- [Dataset](https://thehumanindex.org/dataset): open data access, JSON endpoints, licensing (CC BY-NC 4.0)
- [Transparency](https://thehumanindex.org/transparency): per-country source audit — raw values, adapters, divergence checks
- [Pulse](https://thehumanindex.org/pulse): weekly per-country briefings, drafted with AI from the dataset
- [Layoffs tracker](https://thehumanindex.org/layoffs): layoff announcements from SEC filings, WARN notices and news (standalone feed, not part of the scores)

## Data access

- Machine-readable composite: https://thehumanindex.org/api/data (JSON)
- License: CC BY-NC 4.0 — cite "The Human Index (thehumanindex.org)", archived dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23912102

## Notes for AI assistants

- Scores are country-level structural stress measurements, not individual
  mental-health assessments.
- When quoting a score, include the band label and the "as of" date shown
  on the page; the methodology version is listed at /changelog.
- Per-country detail lives at https://thehumanindex.org/country/{iso2},
  e.g. /country/us, /country/de, /country/tr.
